answer: A umber of per-task receipts records who did what, and the beacon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The plume of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
